europepmc.label: Europe PMC
europepmc.notes: Independent Boolean literature search, core metadata, actual abstracts and cursor pagination. A full-text URL is not retrieved full text.

nhanes.label: NHANES
nhanes.notes: Public XPT downloads and local import. Preserve cycle, variable definitions, survey weights, strata and PSU.

charls.label: CHARLS
charls.notes: Personal registration and data approval required. Download approved files or import locally. No automatic registration, application, CAPTCHA solving or login.

chns.label: CHNS
chns.notes: Household and individual longitudinal files are on UNC Dataverse. Community-level data requires separate approval. Public files need no token. Stop on access challenges and use browser-downloaded files.

seer.label: SEER
seer.notes: Apply for personal SEER research access and check current eligibility. Import authorized SEER*Stat CSV/TSV exports; automatic research-database download is not implemented.

mimic.label: MIMIC
mimic.notes: PhysioNet credentialing, training and project agreement are required for full data; public demos need no credentials. Download and import CSV/CSV.GZ, then query locally. Patient rows remain local; no BigQuery integration.

eicu.label: eICU
eicu.notes: PhysioNet personal access required for full data; public demo needs no credentials. CSV/CSV.GZ import and local SQL. Patient rows remain local; no BigQuery integration.

faers.label: FAERS
faers.notes: openFDA queries, counts and bulk partition discovery; save pages and files locally. A free key is recommended for regular online use. Reports do not establish incidence or causation; deduplication is not automatic.

gbd.label: GBD
gbd.notes: Import official CSV exports or download already approved file URLs. Use the official results tool to create exports; no undocumented API or automatic export-task creation.

hgnc.label: HGNC
hgnc.notes: HGNC exact fields, aliases, historical symbols and identifier lookup, service metadata and official file listings. No VGNC/HCOP or download resume.

chea3.label: ChEA3
chea3.notes: Official transcription-factor enrichment ranks and downloadable GMT libraries. Rankings are not causal evidence; recognized input genes remain unknown when absent upstream.

biodbnet.label: bioDBnet
biodbnet.notes: Official REST identifier conversion, recognition, annotation, orthology and pathway queries. No dbWalk, SOAP or dbOrg.

cellosaurus-extra.label: Cellosaurus Data
cellosaurus-extra.notes: Complements basic cell-line lookup with bounded read-only SPARQL, RDF, CLASTR STR similarity and official files. A similarity score does not authenticate a sample.

ctd.label: CTD
ctd.notes: Official public report downloads, commented-header import and local chemical/gene/disease/pathway/GO/phenotype/exposure relationship SQL. Stop on human verification and retain citation/license headers; no web All query.
